description: Unbranded finance editorial delivery preset. Editable operating targets; no organization affiliation or approval is implied.

editorial.research: Reuse valid supplied research; for a topic, research primary evidence first. A research brief is not a completed report.
editorial.blog_en: Compose a focused argument in English. Body page target excludes supporting source notes; record layout and actual preview.
editorial.article_zh: Native Chinese composition; grounded personal judgment supported by evidence; specific declarative subheadings; restrained emphasis.
editorial.format: UTF-8 text and static HTML, no external resources or JavaScript. Compare visible content with the reviewed canonical text and preview in the chosen publishing editor.
editorial.han_count: Use the core's explicit body-Han convention; headings and the Sources/参考来源 section are excluded. Put any disclaimer outside the body-count scope and report this convention.
editorial.media: English podcast; target total includes authorized intro/outro. Select actual Google product per run. No source audio, no verified provider claim. Generate video only for the video package.
editorial.review: Use the schema-2 article contract. Assign one independent reviewer per applicable criterion: prose, source fidelity, delivery, numerical evidence choice, reader consequences, unaided reader teach-back when background is unfamiliar, ending and comment closure. One writer integrates. Affected reviewers recheck the final version before a fresh reviewer reads the whole article. Renew checks after edits.
editorial.lengths: Targets are advisory until an explicit brief makes them required; report measured values and deviations. Never pad to reach a target.
editorial.filenames: Use V1, V2 or Draft. Version delivery status separately.
editorial.approval: The preset does not require or grant publication approval. Configure the actual organization's approval requirement in delivery.json.

privacy: Keep actual sources, drafts, accounts, organization rules and media outside the public repository.
